rationale: An archival reading room: warm paper, oxblood action ink, bookish serif typography, generous leading, crisp tiny corners and restrained engraved elevation. label: Signal
title: Signal · Original light and dark
rationale: An industrial wayfinding console: black, porcelain and signal yellow, monospaced typography, heavy straight rules, squared controls and hard offset elevation. Independently authored day and night branches preserve a yellow brand while keeping dark text links readable on light paper. Dense information, terse motion, large focus contours, distinct yellow selection and compact geometric collaboration/editor surfaces make the same application feel like a working instrument. Button variant semantics and target protections remain intact.

reference.flavor: Original design study authored with current theme APIs

label: Kinetic
title: Kinetic · Original light and dark
rationale: An exuberant creative clubhouse: oversized rounded headings, violet action paint, coral identity, mint collaboration surfaces, capsule actions and deeply rounded containers. Dark mode is an independent midnight-violet composition with vivid coral and lilac controls. Broad whitespace, enlarged glyphs, chunky focus halos, spring-like eased surface entry and two-stage colored elevation make the reusable system feel playful and physical. Color is assigned to semantic roles and component families instead of flattening every button variant into one style.
